features: Preserve every completion-v1 causal slot; append raw prefix occurrence counts for every token, aligned relative to the visible query. Zero count uses PAD; positive counts use a disjoint categorical value range. Output classes and original token values are unchanged. No task identifier, label, parity answer, or arithmetic rule is a feature.
optimizer: Unchanged completion-v1: retained consumed-prefix CE gradients, unrestricted oracle with optional shared candidate, zero-gradient missing-row completion, exact integer feasible vertex mixtures and fresh full-data CE/gap. No stale-gradient convergence claim.
forward_only: Unchanged consistency search on the expanded key/value alphabet. Prefer globally consistent sharing; otherwise fit each query. One epoch with exact complete-data equivalence, or explicit no-consistent-key failure.
stop: First observed original primary exact accuracy >=99%, or configured update cap; full batch also stops at fresh empirical gap <=1e-8. Forward-only completes one epoch. Every endpoint, explicit failure and capped run remains visible.
interpretation: 48 prospective cells after adaptive/completion failures: three parity representation tests, two order-sensitive depth controls, Boolean and short-recall regressions, and ordinary division. Same source data, metrics, scales, diagnostic caps and observation cadence. Chosen after the earlier results. This is not a new all-35-task result, matched timing test, or transformer comparison. Count features do not guarantee unseen-count identification or length extrapolation.
